title: createAuthenticatedClient() in activity-api and concept-db (repos/activity-api/src/db/surreal.ts, repos/concept-db/src/d
description: createAuthenticatedClient() in activity-api and concept-db (repos/activity-api/src/db/surreal.ts, repos/concept-db/src/db/surreal.ts) called connect() before use()/authenticate() with no try/catch. Any auth-handshake failure (identity-vessel unreachable, JWT issues -- both observed live) leaked the already-open SurrealDB socket forever, since the caller's try/finally around queryWithAuth never started. Confirmed as the root cause of an unbounded SurrealDB connection growth (28->64+) driving a container CPU/thermal emergency (Tctl 100C) on 2026-08-29. Patched in both vessels (wrap connect/use/authenticate in try/catch, close() on failure, rethrow) and verified live -- connection count plateaus under load instead of climbing. NOT YET CHECKED: whether other vessels built from the same TypeScript vessel template (identity-vessel showed the same high-connection-count symptom) share this exact pattern in their own createAuthenticatedClient.
